answer_1.quote: Automatic text simplification (ATS) aims to creates easier-to-read text while keeping the original meaning ... We introduced "legal meaning" as a substitute to "meaning preservation" to evaluate ATS system output for legal text simplification (TS).

answer_2.quote: We selected the following ones: • BERTScore ... • Coverage ... • LENS ... • MeaningBERT ... • QuestEval ... • SBERT ... • SBERT‑Multi ... JUDGEBERT ...

answer_4.quote: We selected five native French‑speaking law students at the Faculty of Law of University Laval as our annotators. ... Annotators use our annotation procedure to annotate each instance ... They assess simplicity, characterization, and legal meaning preservation (LMP).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given an annotation guide and practiced on 15 examples before the full evaluation; they rated simplicity level, characterization class, and a legal meaning preservation score on a 1‑10 Likert scale.
